2 ravnos are in combat and one of them performs horrid reality
the other performs blessing of durga syn and steals it. does he keep
the weapon after combat? I don't thnk so...

Trap and undead persistence are played in combat...how does that go

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <868e25$2ke$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

mads...@my-deja.com wrote:
> 2 ravnos are in combat and one of them performs horrid reality
> the other performs blessing of durga syn and steals it. does he keep
> the weapon after combat? I don't thnk so...

No. It is burned or returned to its owner's library, as appropriate.

> Trap and undead persistence are played in combat...how does that go
> now..is the vampire who played undead persistence now totally immune
> from being burned/going to torpor untill after trap ends?

He is not immune from being burned.
Undead Persistence only protects him form torpor, not from being
burned.
